title: Fucoidan-mediated green synthesis of palladium nanoparticles as a recyclable catalyst for Heck coupling and alkyne reduction in pheromone synthesis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49074-49087

Van-Dung Le, Minh-Vuong Phan, Nhat-Minh Phan, Nguyen-Khanh-Vu Ngo, Thi-Yen-Nghi Le, Truc-Vy Mai, Duc-Huy Pham, Minh-Trong Tran, Minh-Ty Nguyen, Thi-Cam-Thu Nguyen, Thanh-Danh Nguyen, Dinh-Tri Mai, Thi-Ngoc-Mai Tran, Thi-Thanh-Tu Nguyen, Hoang-Nhu-Khanh Huynh, Chi-Hien Dang
A novel PdNPs@Fu catalyst was developed using fucoidan as a dual reducing and stabilizing agent. Microwave irradiation (450 W, 10 min) in water efficiently converted Pd2+ to colloidal metallic Pd0, its stability maintained for more than 30 days.
